description: Return a score of how good the sky is for observing at a latitude right now (night, Moon, quiet Sun). Use it to decide whether to go out; it is not a probability of seeing a UFO. For the Moon alone use moon, for aurora use aurora. Live Vigi-Sky API; clouds are not included.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (north positive).

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

name: observation_conditions

outputSchema.description: Returns observation_conditions_score (or null when unavailable), interpretation, not_ufo_probability (always true).

title: Observing conditions score
